title: Perihelion v1.4.4
content:
This update adds manual folder covers and aspect-ratio scaling fixes to Perihelion.

  • Manual folder covers: Administrators can now set any image as the cover for a folder from the Edit Details panel. A passive badge marks the cover in the gallery.
  • Widescreen scaling fixes: Folder thumbnails now preserve their aspect ratio and use contain-scaling inside grid layouts instead of zooming and cropping.
